method.samples: 48 kHz mono, trimmed (-40 dB rel), -18 LUFS, peak <= -1 dBFS
method.asr: mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo, ko; CER on Hangul only, digits read as Sino-Korean
method.cps: Hangul syllables of the TTS input / trimmed duration
method.f0: Praat AC pitch 65-600 Hz, std and p5-p95 range in semitones re median
method.energy: 10 ms frame RMS dB over speech frames: std; energy_mod = mean |d/dt| of 80 ms-smoothed dB
method.score: f0_p10_p90/base + 0.5*rms_std/base + 0.5*min(cps/base,1.25) - 8*mean_cer - 1 if any line CER>0.15 (base = supertonic3 M2 sp120)
